summary.en: A seated dressing space with extra drawer storage alongside.
summary.zh: 在坐式梳妆区旁增加抽屉收纳。

description.en:
A dressing-table arrangement combining a mirror, work surface and side drawer unit. The separated storage sections make it easier to plan cosmetics, accessories and other small items around the dressing area.
Confirm the complete footprint, stool inclusion and the finish required for your bedroom scheme.
description.zh:
镜面、操作台面与侧边抽屉柜组合，便于围绕梳妆区域分区收纳化妆品、配饰及小件物品。
请核对整套占地尺寸、坐凳配置及卧室搭配所需饰面。

en: Mirror, tabletop and side drawers combined.
Separate storage zones around the seated area.
Confirm the full footprint and accessory inclusions.
zh: 镜面、台面与侧边抽屉组合。
围绕坐式区域设置不同收纳区。
整套占地尺寸及配件范围另行确认。

value.en: Request model-specific order and sample terms
value.zh: 按款式询价确认起订量及样品条件

value.en: Confirm packing, assembly requirements and current lead time
value.zh: 核对包装、组装要求及当前交期
